description: Variation of Condition 2 of approved permission 3428/20: Alterations to approved plans due to technical design development to apartment blocks and subsequent site plan, cycle store and refuse store change (summary)
decision_conditions:
The development hereby permitted shall be begun no later than the  expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Reason: In order to comply with the requirements of Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990.
